data_fields.name: starve_damage_per_tick
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 (starverate; coded per tick, comment says per second)

data_fields.name: food_price_per_item
data_fields.donor_constant: equal to food energy on all 11 shipped items

best_idea: A per-second fed meter (0..100) that drains by a fixed rate, starts a damage-over-time penalty at zero that goes through the one damage path, refills by food with a clamp, and freezes (not rewrites) while asleep or AFK.
decision_why: A real, self-contained condition meter with a zero-threshold penalty and a refill item fits a tired/fed out-of-fight state in a fighting MMO, but it gives no melee stamina (no per-action cost exists in this donor), and the donor's sleep path bypasses the damage writer and its save-restore does nothing, so we keep the meter, adapt it to condition only, and fix those defects.
acceptance: A server test starts at 100 energy with the donor default drain (0.2 per second), reaches 0 after 500 s, then loses health through the one damage function at the coded starvation rate; a 300 s sleep leaves energy unchanged; respawn resets energy to 100 and health to the class maximum.
